image_prompts.purpose: Reading and listening support visual for the Week 1 model student profile.
image_prompts.visual_description: An adult Brazilian Fashion Design student in a tidy studio classroom, holding a sketchbook near fabric swatches and a work table, with a welcoming academic atmosphere.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a soft digital watercolor style with realistic proportions and an adult educational tone.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Show the student, sketchbook, and fabric clearly. Keep the background simple and studio-like, with no crowded details.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, runway glamour poses, childish cartoon style, and heavy background text.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary visual for the word sketch in the starter vocabulary activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clear fashion sketchbook page with one simple garment croquis and visible pencil lines.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a fashion sketch style with clean linework and clear educational readability.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Center the sketchbook page. Make the croquis easy to recognize at small size.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra text labels, multiple competing sketches, and overly technical detail.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary visual for the word fabric in the starter vocabulary activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A close-up textile swatch image with folds and visible material texture suitable for beginners.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use realistic educational product-photo styling with soft light and clear texture.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the fabric central and easy to read, with a neutral background.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid patterns or backgrounds that make the fabric hard to identify.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary visual for the word garment in the starter vocabulary activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A simple garment such as a blouse or dress on a hanger or mannequin, shown clearly as one clothing item.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use realistic catalog-style presentation with simple, clean lighting.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Show only one main garment and keep the silhouette easy to read.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid full outfits, busy styling, brand labels, and crowded retail scenes.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary visual for the word sewing in the starter vocabulary activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A beginner-friendly sewing scene with a sewing machine, fabric, and hands guiding the material.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use realistic classroom-studio styling with clear task visibility.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Focus on the sewing action and materials rather than the full room.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid industrial factory scenes, fashion-show imagery, and unclear hand positions.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary visual for the word patternmaking in the starter vocabulary activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A tabletop with paper pattern pieces, ruler, measuring tape, and pencil in a Fashion Design study setting.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use realistic educational still-life styling with strong object clarity.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Arrange the tools so paper patterns are the main visual cue and the objects remain easy to identify.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid clutter, advanced technical drafting notes, and non-fashion engineering tools.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary and motivation visual for the word portfolio in the Week 1 vocabulary and profile-writing sequence.
image_prompts.visual_description: A simple fashion portfolio board or printed page with sketches, fabric ideas, and short caption blocks, designed for beginner recognition.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished but uncluttered fashion-student presentation style with realistic materials.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Show portfolio elements clearly, but do not make text readable enough to distract from the concept.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, copyrighted designs, dense readable copy, and luxury-brand styling cues.
